name: Derrick Willow Aleoi Yusaf Nate Erickson
equipment: Wooden Staff / Druidic Focus (1d6 bludgeoning, versatile 1d8)
Silver Drop Drink x2 (last use: wild mushroom space trip — observe effects on other species)
Half Price Potion (roll d100 for effect)
spells: Shape Water / Hurl Wave (cantrip, homebrew — 1d8 cold damage)
Grease (free once per long rest via Artificer Initiate)

spellcasting.name: Druid Spellcasting (Wisdom)
spellcasting.desc: Spell save DC 12; spell attack +4. Slots: 3 cantrips, 3 (1st level), 4 (2nd level), 3 (3rd level — wait, level 4 druid gets 3/4/3 per XML slotsCurrent). Prepared spells = Wis mod + druid level = 2 + 4 = 6 spells. Ritual casting available. Spellcasting focus: wooden staff or druidic focus.

spellcasting.name: Circle of Land: Natural Recovery
spellcasting.desc: Once per long rest, during a short rest, recover expended spell slots totalling up to half druid level rounded up (2 levels). Can recover a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit (Dex), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 piercing (finesse). Vex mastery: on hit, advantage on next attack against same target.

actions.name: Wooden Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: -1 to hit (Str), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6-1 bludgeoning (1d8-1 two-handed). Functionally useless in combat — use spells.

actions.name: Wild Shape
actions.desc: Transform into a beast CR 1/2 or lower, no flying speed (level 4). Duration: 2 hours. 2 uses per short or long rest.

actions.name: Cast a Spell
actions.desc: Spell save DC 12; spell attack +4. Key spells: Moonbeam (2d10 radiant, Con save, moves 60ft/turn), Entangle (Str save, restrained), Melf's Acid Arrow (ranged spell attack, 4d4 acid + 2d4 next turn), Healing Word (bonus action, 2d4+2 heal), Cure Wounds (touch, 1d8+2 heal), Darkness (15ft radius magical dark, concentration).

class_features.name: Druidic
class_features.desc: Knows the secret language of druids. Can leave hidden messages readable only by other druids (DC 15 Perception to notice, magic required to decipher).

class_features.name: Wild Shape (Level 4)
class_features.desc: CR 1/2 or lower, no flying speed. Duration 2 hours. 2 uses per short/long rest. Retains Int/Wis/Cha; gains beast's physical stats and HP. Can't cast spells in beast form. Equipment falls, merges, or is worn.

class_features.name: Circle of the Land: Bonus Cantrip
class_features.desc: Learned one additional druid cantrip (Thunderclap taken from the XML).

class_features.name: Circle of the Land: Natural Recovery
class_features.desc: Once per long rest, short rest lets Derrick recover spell slots totalling up to 2 levels (a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots).

class_features.name: Artificer Initiate (Feat)
class_features.desc: Knows Mending cantrip. Can cast Grease once per long rest without a spell slot (uses Intelligence as casting ability). Proficient with Tinker's Tools.

class_features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
class_features.desc: +1 Int, +1 Wis from ASI (reflected in current stats: Int 15, Wis 15).

class_features.name: Companion: Gerrick's Son (Baboon)
class_features.desc: A baboon companion (Derrick calls it Gerrick's Son). AC 12, HP 3, speed 30ft/climb 30ft. Bite: +1 to hit, 1d4-1 piercing. Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is within 5ft of target.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.desc: Double proficiency on History checks related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices.

traits.name: Legalese (Background)
traits.desc: Can use complex legal terminology to frighten, intimidate, or deceive people who don't know better. Advantage on checks to interpret, negotiate, or exploit legal and contractual text. Took law as an elective — talks the talk but doesn't fully understand it.

traits.name: Personality
traits.desc: Gambling addict. In pursuit of medical prowess, experiments on new materials for medicinal purposes. Ideals: Will do anything to further medical career. The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few. Flaws: Cannot read facial expressions or interpret emotions (type of autism). Thirst for experimentation regularly crosses moral lines — never misses a medical opportunity.

goals: Become one of the greatest healers of his time
Gather foreign ingredients and medical knowledge (Silver Drop Drink, Weird Brown Truffle Substance, Odd Mushrooms)
Return home to open a profitable medical centre
Get new robes (currently has Moonspire Robe)
Figure out what assistance Blaine can provide
backstory: A young Rock Gnome who graduated from a prestigious institution with ambitions of becoming the greatest healer of his generation. Studied law as an elective — sounds convincing but doesn't fully understand it. Left home to gather medical knowledge by experimentation, testing unknown substances on whatever subjects are available. Long-term plan: return home with knowledge and exotic ingredients and open a profitable medical centre to fund his gambling addiction. Has befriended Blaine — relationship still being developed. Now has the Moonspire Robe and a baboon companion named Gerrick's Son. Has 2 uses of Inspiration.
notes: Level 4 update: Slots now 3/4/3 (cantrips/1st/2nd). Spell save DC 12, attack +4. New spells: Darkness, Moonbeam, Melf's Acid Arrow. AC is 14 from Moonspire Robe (tracked separately). Has 160gp and a wide collection of experimental substances — hook into these for RP. His Wild Shape now reaches CR 1/2 (crocodile, giant spider, etc). Gerrick's Son baboon companion — find out how this was acquired. Silver Drop Drink causes wild psychedelic effects — 2 remaining. Has 2 Inspiration. Note: Darkness is not on druid spell list — flagged as possibly from Moonspire Robe or another source.
